page_title: HAM 4-0 MAI | Hamburger SV v Mainz 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Robert Hartmann couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) and blew his whistle.
90+1' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Mainz.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
87' Mainz fail to score from a corner as Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger) leaps to collect the ball.
86' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
82' Here's the change. Giorgi Gocholeishvili leaves the pitch and William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) comes on as a substitute.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Rayan Philippe will be replaced by Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger).
82' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Nadiem Amiri is replaced by Lennard Maloney (Mainz).
79' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 36:64.
72' The shot by Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Lasse Riess.
71' Jae-Sung Lee will be replaced by Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz).
69' Mainz keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
67' Fabio Balde (Hamburger) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jean-Luc Dompe.
67' Merlin Polzin has decided to substitute Ransford Konigsdorffer and he is replaced by Robert Glatzel (Hamburger).
65' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) attempts to discuss the decision with Robert Hartmann, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
65' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) has too much to say to the referee and receives a caution.
62' Albert Sambi Lokonga comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jonas Meffert (Hamburger).
62' Substitution. Dominik Kohr will be replaced by Stefan Bell (Mainz).
61' Here is a change. Benedict Hollerbach is going off and Bo Henriksen gives the last tactical orders to Armindo Sieb (Mainz).
61' 4 - 0 Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
60' Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
60' Mainz are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
58' Hamburger SV failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
56' Dangerous play by Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger). Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for a foul.
52' 3 - 0 Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He fires the ball into the top left corner.
51' What a chance that is! Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
49' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Lasse Riess has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
46' A spell of possession for Mainz in an attempt to control the game.
46' Bo Henriksen decides to make a substitution. Phillipp Mwene will be replaced by Nelson Weiper (Mainz).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Robert Hartmann has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The booking goes to Dominik Kohr (Mainz).
45+2' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
45+1' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
41' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Dominik Kohr (Mainz). Robert Hartmann saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.

41' Hamburger SV hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
38' A great run by Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner.
37' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) is lurking on the edge of the box and receives a pass from Albert Sambi Lokonga. He shows nice control before hitting a soft shot just wide of the left post.
36' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) meets an accurate cross inside the six-yard box and attempts a bullet header, but the goalkeeper denies him and makes the save.
34' Daniel Heuer Fernandes leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Paul Nebel (Mainz).
34' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Mainz.
33' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) commits a foul and Robert Hartmann immediately signals a free kick.
31' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the top right corner, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
29' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

26' Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
25' It looks like Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) saw red with that tackle. Robert Hartmann won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

23' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the bottom left corner, Daniel Heuer Fernandes didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
22' Some great controlled play and passing from Mainz. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
19' Daniel Heuer Fernandes reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) towards the roof of the net.
17' Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
17' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Lasse Riess is equal to it and makes an easy save.
16' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Lasse Riess was alert and made an astonishing save!
15' Mainz hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
13' Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
12' Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
10' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) gets on the end of a long pass that is slotted through the defence and easily sends the ball into the bottom left corner!
9' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
5' Good clearance! Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
2' Hamburger SV string together a series of short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Mainz will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Robert Hartmann.
